sql:
SELECT file_type, MAX(created_at)::timestamptz AS latest
      FROM sync_logs
      GROUP BY file_type
captureSql:
SELECT md5(t) AS md5, length(t) AS len, t AS rows_json
FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(q)::text, '[]') AS t FROM (
SELECT file_type, MAX(created_at)::timestamptz AS latest
      FROM sync_logs
      GROUP BY file_type
) q) x
